title: Multi-fill perps orders appear as one activity row
description: Proves a Perps order that filled in several fills is shown as a single activity row carrying the full size, on the Perps asset detail page, the Perps home activity section and the Activity page Perps > Trades subsection. Data prerequisite: Hyperliquid testnet order 60252966679 on the slot fixture account (Trading, 0x316B...01fa) - a SOL long opened during this run that filled in 4 fills of 2.92 + 0.4 + 2.35 + 2.62 = 8.29 SOL, established with metamask.perps.place_order.

setup-restart.intent: Start from a freshly launched app so the trade history loads from scratch

setup-status.intent: Confirm the mobile bridge is reachable

setup-unlock.intent: Reach a signed-in wallet so Perps history is readable

ac1-run-transform-tests.intent: Establish that one order's close, open and flip fills are summed into a single trade entry

ac1-assert-transform-tests.intent: Fail the proof when the fill-grouping rules for close, open and flip are not met

ac1-index-test-log.intent: Keep the fill-grouping test output as reviewable evidence

setup-nav-perps-root.intent: Start from the Perps root so the asset detail page opens from a known place

ac2-nav-market.intent: Reach the SOL asset detail page where this account's SOL trades are listed

setup-ensure-lite.intent: Make sure the asset detail page is the Lite layout that lists recent trades

ac2-wait-trade-rows.intent: See the SOL trade rows finish loading on the asset detail page

ac2-assert-full-size.intent: See the SOL trade reported at the full 8.29 SOL the user actually traded

ac2-scroll-to-trades.intent: Bring the SOL trade rows into the viewport the way a user scrolls to them

ac2-screenshot-market-detail.intent: Show the SOL asset detail page reporting the whole 8.29 SOL open as one trade
ac2-screenshot-market-detail.label: AC2: SOL asset detail reports the full 8.29 SOL opened

ac4-nav-home.intent: Reach the Perps home screen that summarises recent trades

ac4-assert-home-open-total.intent: See the Perps home summary charge the 1.15 dollars that all four fills cost together

ac3-run-flip-test.intent: Establish that a position flip filled in several pieces is summed into one trade
ac3-run-flip-test.cmd:
yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/utils/transactionTransforms.test.ts -t "aggregates flip fills of one order and keeps the opening position size" --no-coverage > temp/tasks/fix/tat-3931-0916-154555/artifacts/flip-test.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -20 temp/tasks/fix/tat-3931-0916-154555/artifacts/flip-test.log
grep -q "Tests:.*1 passed" temp/tasks/fix/tat-3931-0916-154555/artifacts/flip-test.log || exit 1
exit $status

ac3-assert-flip-test.intent: Fail the proof when a multi-fill flip is not summed into one trade

ac3-index-flip-log.intent: Keep the flip grouping test output as reviewable evidence
